mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the prior 3 months indicates monetary easing, reducing discount rates for equity valuation and producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines by > 0.5% over 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds 4.5% for two consecutive months, it signals aggressive monetary policy that increases borrowing costs and suppresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5%, or Rank IC remains above 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) over the prior 3 months indicates labor market tightening that boosts consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances where UNRATE declines and PAYEMS increases simultaneously, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansion, a decline in housing starts (HOUST) relative to the prior 6 months indicates weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where HOUST declines in late-cycle expansion, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained upward trend in retail sales (RSAFS) over the prior 6 months indicates robust consumer spending, which increases corporate revenue and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances where RSAFS rises for 6 consecutive months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 110 (index 2017=100) for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in manufacturing output that reduces corporate profitability and causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where INDPRO < 110, or Rank IC remains above 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and decline in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) over the prior 3 months indicates aggressive monetary tightening during labor market strength, increasing risk premiums and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary tightening during labor market strength
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE falls simultaneously, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market tightness regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), a rising trend in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals continued employment growth that supports consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS rises in a labor market tightness regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), or Rank IC falls below 0.03 in any 3-year rolling window.
